metadata.description: Animesh Debbarma, a prominent senior cabinet minister in the Tripura government and a leading tribal figure in the Tipra Motha party, has been at the forefront of addressing the state's pressing challenges. Known for his dedication, he has extensively toured flood-affected regions to oversee relief efforts and distribute aid. With a rich political background, Debbarma has previously served in the Tripura Tribal Areas Autonomous District Council (TTADC) and played a key role as Leader of the Opposition in the Vidhan Sabha. In an exclusive interview with Main Bhi Bharat's Executive Editor, Chitrita Sanyal, Debbarma opens up about the state's most crucial issues, including governance, tribal rights, and the path forward for Tripura. This candid conversation sheds light on his vision for the state's future and the challenges ahead.
